scope: Pure offline smoke, default-OFF typed-prefix equivalence and independent short-window half QC; no solver, native reader, compiler, subprocess, plot or automatic follow-up.

outputs.fresh_protection: Exclusive create; retained output is never overwritten. Exceptions produce a failed fresh QC JSON, not a rerun.

provenance.actual_call_schema: The native.check itself records direct_native_call, arguments, program, immediate typed LASTEXITCODE, owned exit, start/end, log (possibly null for silent successful readers). There is no invented reader_call Entry.
provenance.bound_Es: Rehash native.check, program, reader_build, sealed_solver, completion, optional log, flat bindings/native_input_files/files arrays. Hash each unique current path once initially and rehash all bound identities after calculations.
provenance.responsibility_boundary: Root native checks own source/build/program/input/solver-call verification. QC verifies those actual sealed direct fields and flat file Entries, without recursively treating old build Git metadata or historical source paths as current.
provenance.solver_records: Current solver records require owned typed exit0/direct call/bindings unchanged; legacy_control uses actual historical solver_finished/owned_exited/exit_code0. No new execution is inferred.
provenance.export_coverage: Bound reader files must exactly cover the immediate export files; native and fixed IDs are read from their actual CSVs.
provenance.live_final: Private last_poro.csv must byte-match the unique live_final.csv Entry in its sealed solver run.files, not an unowned path.

schema.identity: 1040 total native: 40 fixed IDs0..39 and 1000 soil IDs40..1039.
schema.original15: Little-endian uint32 header[1040,15,samples], then each actualtime double8 + all 15 typed ID-aligned native arrays (166400B): 166408B/frame; array-major layout is preserved, not converted/relabelled.
schema.clock: Little-endian uint32[samples,28], then packed records(time double8, savedStep uint32, SymplecticDtPre double8, signed dterror double8). No padding.
schema.physical26: Private-only header[1000,26,samples]; each actualtime double followed by1000x26 doubles. Column21 is actual ExcessPorePress, NOT wave PosDiv.
schema.ownership: Private native outputs contain only three Double J/n/theta arrays; V/rho/k are ledger-derived, and native PosDiv/public model metadata remain absent. OFF has no dynamic arrays and no fabricated ledger.

smoke.checks: Passed owned decode, native3J/private26/IDs/clock and existing native safety/ledger coverage3000+fixed120, plus independent wholebyte last_poro/live_final. Does not claim a half or force-stage proof.

off.checks: Separate native headers validate old151/new21. Compare new entire21*166408B original15 payload against old prefix, plus21*28B complete typed clock payload (including actual time, savedStep, locked dt and signed dterror). native_ids.csv/fixed_ids.csv entire files must byte-match.
off.masks: None: all15 arrays, all1040 native particles including every fixed Rhop are retained. Post-initial legacy fixed density may exceed2100 by its existing production clamp; equality is old/new raw, not a replacement fixed-density constant.

half.predeclared_coarse_completed_steps: 0:10:3990;3991:1:4010;4020:10:5000. Half exactly twice each completed step.
half.checks: Both sealed single native reviews must already pass. ID files and initial complete26 fields are bit-exact; all519 actualtime discrepancies<=1e-14 with no interpolation or snapped times. Match all519 full native pressure RMS<=5Pa and max fullXYZ material displacement difference<=.005mm.
half.drainage: For every post-open saved frame (completedstep>4000 coarse/>8000 half), actual FSType2 or3 receivers must be nonempty and have p==0; cross-check actual counts with history/completion. At exact event4000/8000 pressure is not forced zero. No assumed fixed number of top receivers.
half.descriptive_only: All26 column max differences plus velocity RMS; J/theta/stress/load are descriptive, without new precision gates. V/rho/k ledger guards are inherited from the owned native decode, not independent force-stage measurements.

signed_dterror: Each noninitial native clock interval is finite, nonempty and signed dterror<=1e-14. Initial -DBL_MAX reset sentinel is not a physical safety maximum. No absolute-error reinterpretation.
limits_not_applied: No closed-system energy claim for this loaded/open-drain case
